descriptor:
  id: weekly-group-inventory
  name: Weekly Group Inventory
  description: Reviews all groups and reports on group types for policy oversight.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: policies
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_groups
    format: graph
    label: Load groups
    detail: Retrieves all groups from Microsoft Graph.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /groups
      select:
        - id
        - displayName
        - groupTypes
        - membershipRule
      scopes:
        - Group.Read.All
  - id: count_by_group_type
    format: transform
    label: Count groups by type
    detail: Tallies groups per groupTypes value.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: '{{ load_groups.output }}'
      field: groupTypes
      buckets:
        - All
        - Security
        - Microsoft 365
  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize group landscape
    detail: Generates a short report on group types.
    settings:
      system: >-
        You analyze Microsoft 365 group data for policy review. Be concise and
        factual.
      prompt: >-
        Total groups: {{ load_groups.output | length }}. Distribution: {{ count_by_group_type.output }}.
        Provide a brief summary of the group landscape.
      temperature: 0.2
      maxTokens: 200
definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
    - id: weekly
      kind: scheduled
      intervalSeconds: 604800
  result:
    summary: '{{ summarize.output }}'
    data:
      totalGroups: '{{ load_groups.output | length }}'
      groupDistribution: '{{ count_by_group_type.output }}'

descriptor:
  id: top-noncompliant-models
  name: Top Noncompliant Models
  description: Lists the oldest managed devices by model and compliance state.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: devices
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_devices
    format: graph
    label: Load managed devices
    detail: Retrieves managed devices from Microsoft Graph.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /deviceManagement/managedDevices
      select:
        - id
        - deviceName
        - model
        - complianceState
        - lastSyncDateTime
      scopes:
        - DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All
  - id: count_by_compliance
    format: transform
    label: Count devices by compliance state
    detail: Counts devices grouped by complianceState.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: "{{ load_devices.output }}"
      field: complianceState
      buckets:
        - compliant
        - noncompliant
        - unknown
  - id: sort_oldest
    format: transform
    label: Sort devices by last sync date
    detail: Orders devices by lastSyncDateTime ascending and takes the first 10.
    settings:
      kind: sort-by
      source: "{{ load_devices.output }}"
      field: lastSyncDateTime
      direction: asc
      take: 10
  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize findings
    detail: Generates a short report of the oldest noncompliant devices.
    settings:
      system: >-
        You are an assistant that reports on managed devices for Microsoft 365
        admins. Be concise and factual.
      prompt: >-
        Here are the oldest managed devices: {{ sort_oldest.output }}. Provide a
        brief summary highlighting the number of noncompliant devices and any
        notable models.
      temperature: 0.2
      maxTokens: 200
definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
  result:
    summary: "{{ summarize.output }}"
    data:
      total: "{{ load_devices.output | length }}"
      noncompliantCount: "{{ count_by_compliance.output.noncompliant }}"
